title: Meeting the Bali bombing leader, who believed the Protocols

tellings.quote: >> so I mean this stuff is there. Uh I was met a terrorist the leader the guy who created the Bali bombings in 2002.

plain: An author and historian named Peter Levenda says he met the man who planned the 2002 Bali bombings, a terror attack in Indonesia, and that this man believed in The Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a text that claims to reveal a secret Jewish plan to rule the world. Levenda tells it first-hand, as proof that such writings still drive real violence.
